$comment: Time, scheduling and leave values from the law for docs/27 and migration 0013. Merge into the employment standards edition in Step 7 with the other additions files. Every entry is verify_at_load or secondary until checked against the statute; a jurisdiction an organization uses with no entry stops with JURISDICTION_RULE_MISSING when the value is needed (for an exemption, HR cannot pick one until the province's list is loaded).

keys.overtime_exemptions: Who the province's overtime (or hours of work) rules do not apply to. HR picks one of these codes, with the legal basis, when it marks a position exempt (docs/27 §5.3). An excluded employee is still paid for every hour worked.
keys.schedule_notice: Notice the law requires before a work schedule starts or a shift changes, what the employee may do when it is shorter, and whether an agreement may change it. Where an agreement or the law sets none, the organization's scheduling.notice_days applies (docs/27 §9.1).

list.name_en: Managers, superintendents and employees who exercise management functions
list.name_fr: Directeurs, chefs et employés exerçant des fonctions de direction

list.name_en: Members of the professions designated by regulation (architecture, dentistry, engineering, law, medicine)
list.name_fr: Membres des professions désignées par règlement (architecture, art dentaire, génie, droit, médecine)
list.basis: Canada Labour Code, s. 167(2); Canada Labour Standards Regulations

schedule_notice.cite: Canada Labour Code, Part III (work schedules and shift changes); ESDC, Labour Standards questions and answers

list.name_en: Work that is supervisory or managerial in character, with non-supervisory or non-managerial tasks only on an irregular or exceptional basis
list.name_fr: Travail de nature surveillante ou de direction, les tâches non surveillantes ou non liées à la direction n'étant exécutées qu'irrégulièrement ou exceptionnellement
list.basis: O. Reg. 285/01 (exemptions from Part VIII, overtime pay)

list.name_en: Information technology professionals (duties primarily systems analysis or programming)
list.name_fr: Professionnels des technologies de l'information (fonctions principalement d'analyse de systèmes ou de programmation)
list.basis: O. Reg. 285/01 (exemptions from Part VIII, overtime pay)

list.name_en: Regulated professionals the regulation excludes from hours of work and overtime (for example accountants, architects, engineers, lawyers, doctors), practising their profession
list.name_fr: Professionnels réglementés que le règlement exclut des heures de travail et des heures supplémentaires (par exemple comptables, architectes, ingénieurs, avocats, médecins), exerçant leur profession

schedule_notice.cite: No general schedule notice found in the Employment Standards Act, 2000; to confirm

list.name_en: Managers, as the regulation defines them
list.basis: Employment Standards Regulation, s. 34(f) and s. 1 (definition of manager)

list.name_en: High technology professionals of a high technology company
list.name_fr: Professionnels de la haute technologie d'une entreprise de haute technologie

list.name_en: Teachers, and noon-hour supervisors and teacher's aides of school boards and independent schools
list.name_fr: Enseignants, et surveillants du midi et aides-enseignants des conseils scolaires et des écoles indépendantes

list.name_en: Municipal police officers and paid fire fighters
Live-in home support workers, night attendants and residential care workers
list.name_fr: Préposés au soutien à domicile résidant chez le client, préposés de nuit et préposés en établissement résidentiel

list.name_en: University faculty and college and institute instructors
list.name_fr: Professeurs d'université et formateurs de collèges et d'instituts

list.name_en: Another group the regulation lists (guides, exploration, marine, commercial travellers and the others in s. 34)
list.name_fr: Autre groupe énuméré par le règlement (guides, exploration, marine, voyageurs de commerce et les autres de l'art. 34)

overtime_exemptions.note: Excluded employees are still paid for all time worked, at their regular rate (BC Interpretation Guidelines, s. 34).

schedule_notice.cite: Employment Standards Act, s. 31 (posting hours of work); no number of days found; to confirm
